key_improvements: Task Management: with_skill now passes all 3 assertions (was 2/3). Used base:query instead of Glob+Read for listing.
Task Management: without_skill tool calls dropped from 66 to 12 (natural model improvement, not skill-related).
Summarize Sessions: with_skill token savings 44% (25K vs 45K). Iteration-1 was 38% savings.
Vault Health: with_skill 2x faster than without_skill (95s vs 196s). Iteration-1 was 8.3x faster (33s vs 275s).
Canvas without_skill: Now passes all 3 assertions (was 2/3 in iteration-1) — added toEnd=arrow.

notes: KEY WIN: Task Management with_skill now 3/3 pass rate (was 2/3). base:query on tasks-default.base replaced Glob+Read — the primary goal of the skill improvements.
SUMMARIZE: Minimal-context pattern (outline+properties) saved 44% tokens (25K vs 45K). The CLI-first principle is being followed.
VAULT HEALTH: CLI version 2x faster (95s vs 196s) but tool call count increased to 14 (was 8 in iter-1) due to reading skill files + extra analysis.
QUERY BASE: base:query saved 56% time (68s vs 154s) though token usage was similar (31K vs 29K) since base:query output was large.
CANVAS: without_skill improved to 3/3 (added toEnd=arrow) — this is model improvement, not skill delta.
TOKEN OVERHEAD: with_skill agents now read 2-3 skill files (~1500 lines total), adding base token overhead. The CLI efficiency gains more than compensate for complex tasks.
REMAINING ISSUE: Summarize sessions with_skill still exceeds 2000 char output limit (3333 chars). The skill could add guidance on output brevity.
